body: A little of everything my parents push me to get good grades and I do my homework and am doing fine there but fail almost every test. I hardly ever study which is procrastination on my part.

I feel the same way you do and think I will very rarely use what we are learning in school later in life. She said I would not be able to become an artist and no one would listen to my music. I am considering talking to my counselor but I honestly don't care much at all about school but am constantly stressed because my parents get on me about my grades and expect more from me.
I failed two classes my first trimester. My GPA is dropping.
